definitions.explanation: A phrase or sentence that is difficult to say quickly because of similar or tricky sound combinations, used as a word game or pronunciation exercise.

examples.japanese: {早口言葉|はやくちことば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早口言葉|はやくちことば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese tongue twisters are good pronunciation practice.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{早口言葉|はやくちことば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い{合|あ}って→言い合う：21474_iiau⟧⟦{笑|わら}っていた→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: The children were saying tongue twisters to each other and laughing.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{早口|はやくち}→早口：04321_hayakuchi⟧ (fast talking) and ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (words). A popular word game in Japan, especially among children. Famous Japanese tongue twisters include 「{生麦|なまむぎ}{生米|なまごめ}⟦{生卵|なまたまご}→生卵：19011_namatamago⟧」 (raw barley, raw rice, raw egg) and 「⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦{特許|とっきょ}→特許：13467_tokkyo⟧{許可局|きょかきょく}」 (Tokyo Patent Approval Office).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早口言葉|はやくちことば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧: to try a tongue twister
- {早口言葉|はやくちことば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say a tongue twister
- {早口言葉|はやくちことば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play with tongue twisters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{早口|はやくち}→早口：04321_hayakuchi⟧: fast talking — the speed of speech itself, not the word game
- ⟦{言葉遊|ことばあそ}び→言葉遊び：24304_kotobaasobi⟧: wordplay — a broader category that includes tongue twisters, puns, and riddles
